workspace_files.MEMORY.md:
## User
- User prefers insight over volume — a single well-framed comparison beats ten raw links.
- Comparative framing is often more useful than isolated facts.
- User cares about depth and nuance; shallow recency-biased takes erode trust.

## Preferences
- Do not pass along half-baked findings. Hold until you can say something structured.
- When multiple signals relate to the same topic, cluster and synthesize before surfacing.
- If confidence is low or evidence is thin, say so explicitly rather than hedging with vague language.
